newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst earns 2.6 bln dmk on disinvestments.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst earns 2.6 bln dmk on disinvestments.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG said on Wednesday it had earned 2.6 billion marks before tax in 1996 on disinvestments.
The main part of the earnings would not be included in the firm's results, but only in pre-tax profits, Hoechst head of finance Klaus-Juergen Schmeider told journalists.
The returns from the sales would mainly be taxed in Germany and the allotted tax revenue would be about 1.4 billion marks, Schmeider said.
Hoechst said according to German tax law it would not be taxing the disposal profits immediately. The disposals will be dissolved effectively in next year's results.
